name: gPhotos2Immich
description: gPhotos2Immich syncs Google Photos shared albums to Immich on a schedule, without any Google API key: it reads public shared-album links, downloads full-quality photos and videos with their taken dates and skips items already uploaded. The web UI shows live logs and has a Sync Now button; a sync can also be triggered with POST /api/sync (e.g. from Home Assistant). First launch: create config.json (see Requires), open the WebUI, enter the Immich API URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2283/api) and an Immich API key with the asset.read, asset.upload, album.create, album.read, album.update, albumAsset.create and user.read permissions (or All), then add your shared album links. Changes apply without a restart. Only public shared links work: check that the album opens in a private browser window. The web UI has no password: never expose its port to the internet.

paths.name: Config file
paths.description: Settings file written by the WebUI (create it first, see Requires)

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Sync state used to skip items already uploaded

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Internal listen port (must match WebUI Port container port)

variables.name: DISABLE_WEBUI
variables.description: true turns the WebUI off (config.json must then be written by hand)
